notes.title: A new build of Anti-Opoly is released!
notes.notes: We have worked on the localization of the builds to be more precise word wise, but if you see something in the translation that is not correct, please let us know in the forums.

notes.title: An update for Anti-Opoly has been released
notes.notes:
We have fixed the display issue on Mac OSX 10.11

You will also notice that there is an update available for PC as well. We did not change anything to the PC version except the version number to keep it up to par with the build on Mac OSX.
